- The Fernhill end-to-end SSO walkthrough is Thursday 10am NY time on staging with their Okta tenant; Priya runs the demo, you just need to be on the call [1].
- Tom wants PR #423 split: the `saml_utils` module move separated from the lint fixes, as two PRs he'd approve today — the frozen-clock tests, ruff/mypy fixes and the split all sit in that one 1,900-line diff [1][4].

## What changed
- Maya approved and merged #418 (SAML signature verification) last night; it goes out with tonight's staging deploy [3].

- Cleared the ruff 0.8 and mypy backlog in `kestrel/auth`, including a missing Issuer/Subject now rejected with a 401 instead of crashing into a 500, covered by a new test [1].
